messages:
Alex: handing off primary for the next 8h — quick summary of current ongoing: observability ingestion errors (INC-2028), some traces/metrics missing for us-west customer traffic. Root cause looks like sidecar v2->v3 compatibility mismatch on the collector pods causing JSON decode errors.

Alex: actions so far:
- rolled back collector sidecar to v2 on us-west (partial)
- routed ~30% of incoming traffic to fallback-collector cluster in us-east
- increased ingestion buffer to 120s for affected shard
- opened INC-2028 and pinged support before customers noticed major impact

Alex: open items for whoever is primary next (cc @Maria @Jin):
- monitor the error rate on /collector/ingest (dashboard link below)
- if error rate > 5% for 10m, promote fallback cluster to primary (see commands)
- coordinate with edge to reroute critical customers if errors spike

Alex: runbook pointers: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/observability-ingest — follow the "collector compatibility" section (step 3).

Maria: ack — thanks. I'm taking secondary now. I'll keep watch on customer-impact channel and update status.

OncallBot: INC-2028 opened by alex — severity P2 — pages sent to eng-oncall, oncall-sre. PagerID: pager-8791.

Jin: quick note — we saw a malformed payload pattern: missing "metadata.version" field, collector rejects with 400. Looks like v3 introduced stricter schema. If we can't fully roll back, we can apply a schema-looser filter at the edge for 2 hours as a temporary mitigation.

Priya: suggestion — apply the filter only for customers with active sessions (to reduce noise). I can put that in place; need 10m window to test.

Alex: please do. Commands below for immediate actions (run as infra-admin):
```bash
# failover traffic to fallback collector cluster
kubectl -n edge patch svc collector --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/selector/cluster","value":"fallback-us-east"}]'
# restart affected collector deployment (if rolling back)
kubectl -n observability rollout restart deployment/collector-uswest
```

Maria: I'm watching dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/obs-ingest/us-westingest — setting alert: if p50 latency > 300ms or error_rate > 3% for 5m, escalate.

Alex: handoff notes for whoever takes over at shift end:
- Primary: Alex (now handing off) -> after 30m, if error_rate stable < 2% for 30m, hand back to normal rotation.
- Secondary: Maria (current) -> will own customer comms if we need targeted reroutes.
- Next on-call (overnight): Jin -> please be ready to run the fallback promotion script; I've left it in /ops/scripts/promotion.sh and it requires infra-admin token.

Jin: copy. I'll test promotion script in staging now and leave comments. If we need to promote, call out the exact timestamp window so we can coordinate with edge team.

Priya: deploy filter patch applied to the canary namespace (tested) — pushing to prod canary in 5m. Will report results.

OncallBot: Pager update: INC-2028 — last state: mitigation in progress (collector rollback + partial traffic failover). Next check-in scheduled in 15m.

Maria: minor customer impact observed: one internal customer reported delayed traces in dashboard (no missing logs). I've notified CX for potential email if this widens.

Alex: escalation criteria (if triggered -> escalate to SRE-Lead and exec):
- error_rate > 10% for 10m
- >2 high-value customers reporting missing traces
- fallback cluster fails during promotion attempt

SRE-Lead: noted. If escalation, I'll join bridge and loop in infra and product.

Jin: promotion script test: passes in staging. Steps to promote (for reference):
```bash
# run promotion script (will update routing and adjust RBAC)
/ops/scripts/promotion.sh --from us-west --to fallback-us-east --dry-run false
```

Alex: coverage gaps to be aware of: night shift has limited infra-admin bandwidth (only Priya and Jin can run promotion). If both are unavailable, we need to escalate earlier to SRE-Lead.

Maria: leaving a short checklist for handoff message I'll post to the main oncall channel at end of my watch:
- current error_rate and sample logs attached
- list of mitigation steps and who to call (Priya/Jin/SRE-Lead)
- pointer to runbook + promotion script location

Alex: final: if you take primary and see any customer-side 5xx spikes, do NOT promote fallback until you confirm fallback has healthy RBAC tokens. We saw token expiry last week causing further errors.

Priya: confirmed — when promoting I'll rotate service tokens first, TTL ~ 30m.

Maria: I'll take handoff formally at 1779995400 (in ~7m) and post status. If anyone needs to reach me faster: @Maria (mobile).

Alex: thanks all — leaving notes in INC-2028 timeline. Good handoff and please escalate if anything changes. :thumbsup:

OncallBot: Thread marked for handoff summary. Next automated check at 1779995167.
